summary.oneLiner: Vedant Fashions delivered robust Q4FY26 retail sales growth of 7.8% and PAT growth of 13%, driven by record-breaking marketing campaigns and disciplined SSG improvement of 2.7% for FY26; the company is shifting from volume-led expansion to quality-led retail, prioritizing higher ASP via product upgradation and rationalizing underperforming stores, while sustaining industry-leading 65%+ gross margins despite GST normalization headwinds.

one-line thesis: Vedant Fashions delivered robust Q4FY26 retail sales growth of 7.8% and PAT growth of 13%, driven by record-breaking marketing campaigns and disciplined SSG improvement of 2.7% for FY26; the company is shifting from volume-led expansion to quality-led retail, prioritizing higher ASP via product upgradation and rationalizing underperforming stores, while sustaining industry-leading 65%+ gross margins despite GST normalization headwinds.
financial scorecard: revenue: +8.7% YoY (Q4), +3.5% YoY (FY); EBITDA/margin: 45.6% (Q4), 44.3% (FY) — stable despite GST impact; PAT (rptd): +13% YoY (Q4), +11% YoY (FY); PAT (normalized): ~+15% YoY (Q4) — adjusting for GST distortion; order book: not disclosed; net debt: net cash position (no debt mentioned, cash conversion ratio 98%)
guidance: revenue growth: no explicit guidance, but confidence in sustained SSG momentum; margin: gross margin to remain ~65%+ despite 50-150 bps input cost inflation; order inflow: no specific guidance; capex/commissioning: no capex guidance, but Twamev EBOs have 18-20 month lead time for openings
segment / subsidiary detail: Manyavar: core brand, 669 stores; Mohey: 8 standalone EBOs, higher ASP than Manyavar; Twamev: 8 standalone EBOs, highest revenue/sq ft, build-to-suit stores with 18-20 month lead time; Mebaz: focused on wedding/occasion wear; Diwas: digital-only, no physical stores planned; combined Manyavar-Mohey stores: all upgraded, no retrofitting possible
growth verticals / optionality: Expansion into high-throughput neighborhoods with 1,000 sq ft Manyavar kurta-only stores; potential for own quick-commerce app/dark hubs; untapped markets like South Bombay (Lower Parel+); new India tier-2 cities (e.g., Bhopal) with high rental friction
margins & cost dynamics: Gross margin held at 65.7% (FY) despite 150 bps contraction — primarily due to GST rate normalization (not input inflation); fabric cost impact estimated at INR 1-1.5 per INR 100 MRP product, absorbed via SKU upgradation, not price hikes; no margin pressure from franchisees
capex / expansion: no explicit capex guidance; Twamev EBOs require build-to-suit construction (18-20 month lead time); net retail area addition: +1 lakh sq ft gross in FY26; net addition: +4,200 sq ft
capital allocation: Historically paid 50% of profits as dividends; currently under internal review for policy update — no concrete decision yet; cash reserves available for inorganic plays but no active targets; acquisition interest exists but scale of targets too small to justify cost
risks & watch-items: High rental inflation in tier-2 cities delaying store openings; reliance on wedding-centric demand; potential GST volatility; competition from regional players entering/exiting cycle; no quick-commerce integration due to third-party warehouse model
management quality / tone: Confident, disciplined, and long-term oriented; emphasis on SSG over store count; proud of marketing ROI (1B+ views for Made for Each Other); transparent on GST distortion; cautious on capex due to rental environment; open to acquisitions but no active pipeline
non-obvious takeaways: 1. 85% higher revenue/sq ft in new vs closed stores — indicates superior location selection, not just size; 2. Twamev’s 18-20 month lead time means current signings are for FY28/FY29 openings; 3. Diwas digital sales are scaling but inventory cannot be used by Zilo/Blinkit — company may need to build its own logistics; 4. 5-6% of retail area is underperforming — higher than typical 2-3%, signaling aggressive rationalization underway

themes.title: Jewellery & wedding-economy formalization
themes.need: Organized jewellery is gaining share via capital-light FOCO expansion and GST/hallmarking formalization, even amid record gold-price volatility. KALYANKJIL posted Q4 revenue +66% YoY with 150 new FY27 stores and a near-zero non-GML-debt target; SENCO/PNGJL/DPABHUSHAN ride regional formalization; SKYGOLD/RGL/GOLDIAM on B2B and lab-grown export; KALAMANDIR on the wedding-wear economy.
themes.driver: Akshaya Tritiya / wedding-season demand; FOCO store rollout; gold-price stabilization lifting volumes.
